written: 2026-10-15 by huntapp-ba for the nightly loop (huntapp-c4)
rules: Bounds are what the evidence allows, not search ranges to the edge of sense: stay inside them.

Sweep one group at a time against baseline on the same runs; a best variant must pass both cards (PALM: misses not up, tune threat up or held, held-out not down; checks: within-1-sd coverage toward 68% and never below its start).
scorecard.py variants take floor and tune today; spread, lee and slot need their setters added to its CONE_JS (each setter resets to defaults with null).
The shown sigma, check fit and wind card don't read spread.*; floor, lee and slot move the wind itself, so they also need palm_compare.py and replay.py direction scores.

knobs.name: releaseMin
knobs.note: how long the sit has been releasing; a stalk is a minute or two

knobs.name: followMin
knobs.note: how long each puff is tracked

knobs.name: burstS
knobs.note: how long a gust lasts in a gusty hour

knobs.name: calmSpread
knobs.note: how far the direction opens as the wind dies below 2 km/h; 0 keeps the drift

knobs.name: swirlSpread
knobs.note: behind a tree line, in a small opening, a slot across the wind

knobs.name: treesSpread
knobs.note: extra spread inside a stand

knobs.name: checkTighten
knobs.note: the spread as a share of itself when nearby checks agree; lower trusts the puff more

knobs.name: meander
knobs.note: how much of the spread the whole plume wanders through over the sit

knobs.name: meanderS
knobs.note: how slowly the plume wanders

knobs.name: gustSize
knobs.note: the turbulent kicks on each puff

knobs.name: vertMix
knobs.note: how fast a puff thins upward; more is a shorter cone at nose height

knobs.name: canopyMix
knobs.note: extra mixing per unit of closure up at the canopy top, where its sweeps are

knobs.name: trunkMix
knobs.note: the share of the canopy's mixing that reaches the floor by day; none on a still night

knobs.name: bushMix
knobs.note: extra mixing per unit of bush thickness

knobs.name: sunMix
knobs.note: extra mixing by day over open ground (and less under trees)

knobs.name: stableDepth
knobs.note: the settled air on a still night, 5–30 m as modelled; the scent stays in it

knobs.name: tumbleMix
knobs.note: in a lee eddy or a swirl behind trees the scent thins upward faster too; 0 spreads it sideways only

knobs.name: deposition
knobs.note: what needles, leaves and bush take out of the air; 0 is none

knobs.name: bushTrap
knobs.note: how much a wall of bush slows the air at nose height, 0 none to 1 stopped

knobs.name: openShare
knobs.note: the share of the 10 m wind at the top of the layer over open ground

knobs.name: edgeLift
knobs.note: how far up the canopy the puff rides at a windward edge, as a share of the stand height

knobs.name: edgeDrop
knobs.note: the head wind as a share of what the puff had, below which it is an edge

knobs.name: sepSlope
knobs.note: a lee face steeper than this is passed over by day; 0.3 is 17°

knobs.name: sepWind
knobs.note: the forecast wind below which a lee face and a bank make no eddy, whole at twice this; 0 is any wind

knobs.name: cavityBack
knobs.note: the low air under a bank upwind runs back toward it at this share of the wind

knobs.name: bodyRise
knobs.note: how high your own warmth lifts the scent in cold calm air

knobs.name: keepDrop
knobs.note: on a stable night how much of a drop in the ground the puff keeps as height

knobs.name: floor.trees
knobs.note: head-height share under a stand over the baked profile; PALM 1/0.68, towers more

knobs.name: floor.open
knobs.note: open ground and water; Searchmont open checks ran x1.2 already, x1.3 broke its calm checks

knobs.name: spread.cap
knobs.note: place spread's top in unsettled air with wind above the trees (PALM point spread); 110 = no cap

knobs.name: spread.u0
knobs.note: local 10 m km/h where the cap starts

knobs.name: spread.u1
knobs.note: local 10 m km/h where the cap is whole

knobs.name: spread.swing
knobs.note: tongue's whole-plume swing as a share of the place spread; PALM measured 0.39-0.58 across 13 boxes

knobs.name: spread.forecast
knobs.note: forecast's head-height direction error, deg; fitted on Pickle checks (66% within 1 sd), Searchmont held out 71%

knobs.name: spread.checkPull
knobs.note: how far a nearby check pulls model+forecast doubt in: / (1 + checkPull x weight)

knobs.name: lee.rise0
knobs.note: upwind rise (deg within 300 m) where the lee starts

knobs.name: lee.rise1
knobs.note: upwind rise where the lee is whole

knobs.name: lee.back
knobs.note: lee share past which the floor runs back up the slope

knobs.name: lee.open
knobs.note: lee share over open ground

knobs.name: lee.conv
knobs.note: how much a sunny mix cuts the lee

knobs.name: slot.along
knobs.note: along-slot share of the wind that runs the slot

knobs.name: slot.cross
knobs.note: cross flow out the open end (PALM: none)

knobs.name: slot.pump
knobs.note: return eddy near the wall (PALM: none)

knobs.name: slot.maxSlope
knobs.note: steepest 30 m slope a slot may sit on, deg
